question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Imperious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Meek.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Imperious" means arrogantly domineering or overbearing; expecting obedience. (घमंडी)

◦ Example: The imperious manager demanded instant compliance and rarely tolerated any questioning of her decisions.

 

• "Meek" means quiet, gentle, and easily imposed upon; submissive, and is therefore the correct antonym. (विनम्र)

◦ Example: The once meek intern gradually gained the confidence to voice her own ideas in meetings.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Overbearing (रोबीला): unpleasantly domineering — a synonym of imperious, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Autocratic (निरंकुश): taking no account of others' wishes; dictatorial — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Domineering (दबंग): tending to control or dominate others — close in sense to imperious.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of imperious: domineering, overbearing, autocratic, dictatorial, haughty.

• Synonyms of meek: submissive, docile, humble, timid, yielding.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Connive (मिलीभगत करना): Oppose (विरोध करना), Prevent (रोकना)

2. Conscious (जागरूक): Unaware (अनजान), Unconscious (अचेत)

3. Consent (सहमति): Dissent (असहमति), Interdiction (प्रतिबंध)

4. Continued (जारी): Stopped (रुका)

5. Contracts (सिकुड़ना): Expands (फैलना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Forgo".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Conquer.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Forgo" means to give up or do without something desired. (त्यागना)

◦ Example: Athletes often forgo desserts and other indulgent foods while preparing intensely for competitions.

 

• "Conquer" means to defeat or overcome and gain control of something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्राप्त करना/जीतना)

◦ Example: The young general managed to conquer several neighbouring kingdoms within a single decade.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Relinquish (त्याग देना): to give up a right or possession — a synonym of forgo, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Waive (छोड़ देना): to voluntarily give up a right or claim — again a synonym.

• Option 3: Renounce (त्याग करना): to formally give up a claim or title — close in sense to forgo.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of forgo: Relinquish, Renounce, Waive, Abstain, Sacrifice.

• Synonyms of conquer: Defeat, Overcome, Subdue, Vanquish.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Contumacious (अवज्ञाकारी): Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Compliant (मानने वाला)

2. Convenient (सुविधाजनक): Inopportune (असुविधाजनक), Difficult (कठिन)

3. Convicted (अपराधी): Acquitted (दोषमुक्त), Innocent (निर्दोष)

4. Convince (मनाना): Dissuade (रोकना), Discourage (हतोत्साहित)

5. Copious (प्रचुर): Scarce (कमी), Limited (सीमित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Incredible".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Ordinary.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Incredible" means impossible or difficult to believe; extraordinary. (अद्भुत)

◦ Example: The rescue team performed an incredible feat by saving the trapped miners after three days underground.

 

• "Ordinary" means with no special or distinctive features; normal or usual, and is therefore the correct antonym. (साधारण)

◦ Example: It was just an ordinary Tuesday morning until the unexpected phone call changed everything for the family.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Unbelievable (अविश्वसनीय): not able or difficult to be believed — a synonym of incredible, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Extraordinary (असाधारण): very unusual or remarkable — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Astonishing (आश्चर्यजनक): extremely surprising or impressive — close in sense to incredible.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of incredible: extraordinary, unbelievable, astonishing, remarkable, amazing.

• Synonyms of ordinary: normal, usual, common, typical, average.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Cosy (आरामदायक): Uncomfortable (असुविधाजनक), Uneasy (बेचैन)

2. Covert (गुप्त / छिपा): Overt (खुला), Explicit (स्पष्ट)

3. Coy (शर्मीला): Extroverted (बहिर्मुखी)

4. Credulous (भोला): Skeptical (संदेहवादी), Doubtful (संदेहपूर्ण)

5. Cruel (क्रूर): Kind (दयालु), Compassionate (दयावान)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Approach."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Retreat.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Approach" means come near or nearer to someone or something in distance. (पास आना)

 

• "Retreat" means withdraw from a place or situation, typically due to danger. It is therefore the correct antonym. (पीछे हटना)

◦ Example: Facing overwhelming resistance, the troops were forced to retreat to their original position before nightfall.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Near (निकट आना) — come close to in space or time; a synonym of approach.

• Option 2: Advance (आगे बढ़ना) — move forward, typically in a purposeful way; a synonym of approach.

• Option 4: Converge (एकत्रित होना) — come together from different directions; a synonym of approach.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of approach: Withdraw, Recede, Retire.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Cumbersome (भारी/परेशानीजनक): Convenient (सुविधाजनक), Easy (आसान)

2. Curse (अभिशाप देना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Bless (आशीर्वाद देना)

3. Cursory (सरसरी / सतही): Thorough (गहराई से), Detailed (विस्तृत)

4. Curtail (घटाना): Increase (बढ़ाना), Expand (विस्तार करना)

5. Customary (परंपरागत): Unusual (असामान्य)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Malice."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Kindness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Malice" means the intention or desire to do harm to another person. (द्वेष)

 

• "Kindness" means the quality of being friendly, generous, and considerate. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दयालुता)

◦ Example: The nurse's kindness toward frightened patients earned her the gratitude of the entire hospital ward.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Animosity (शत्रुता) — strong hostility or dislike; a synonym of malice.

• Option 3: Spite (द्वेष) — a desire to hurt or upset someone; a synonym of malice.

• Option 4: Rancor (कटुता) — bitter resentment or ill will; a synonym of malice.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of malice: Goodwill, Benevolence, Compassion.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Damaged (क्षतिग्रस्त): Flawless (निर्दोष), Perfect (संपूर्ण)

2. Dark (अंधेरा): Bright (चमकीला), Light (प्रकाश)

3. Debacle (पराजय): Success (सफलता), Triumph (विजय)

4. Debonair (खुशदिल/आकर्षक): Cheerless (उदास), Hopeless (निराश)

5. Decamp (भाग जाना): Remain (रहना), Stay (ठहरना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Abominable".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Admirable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Abominable" means extremely unpleasant, repulsive, or morally offensive. (घृणित)

◦ Example: Historians described the massacre as an abominable act that shocked the entire international community.

 

• "Admirable" means deserving great respect and approval from other people, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रशंसनीय)

◦ Example: Her admirable courage during the crisis inspired everyone who witnessed her calm and steady leadership.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Detestable (घृणित): deserving intense dislike — a synonym of abominable, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Odious (घृणास्पद): extremely unpleasant or repulsive — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Repugnant (घिनौना): extremely distasteful or offensive — close in sense to abominable.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of abominable: Detestable, Repugnant, Odious, Horrible, Loathsome.

• Synonyms of admirable: Commendable, Praiseworthy, Laudable, Exemplary, Estimable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Deceptive (भ्रामक): Honest (ईमानदार), Truthful (सत्यवादी)

2. Deficient (कमी वाला): Ample (पर्याप्त), Sufficient (पर्याप्त)

3. Defile (अपवित्र करना): Purify (शुद्ध करना), Sanctify (पवित्र करना)

4. Definite (निश्चित): Vague (अस्पष्ट), Uncertain (अनिश्चित)

5. Defy (अवहेलना करना): Yield (समर्पण करना), Obey (आज्ञा मानना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ambrosial."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Malodorous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Ambrosial" means extremely pleasant to taste or smell; delicious. (सुगंधित/स्वादिष्ट)

 

• "Malodorous" means having an unpleasant or foul smell. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दुर्गंधयुक्त)

◦ Example: The malodorous garbage dump made residents close their windows even during hot summer nights.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Heavenly (अत्यंत मनभावन) — extremely pleasant or delightful; a synonym of ambrosial.

• Option 2: Fragrant (सुगंधित) — having a pleasant smell; a synonym of ambrosial.

• Option 4: Delectable (स्वादिष्ट) — delicious and highly enjoyable to taste; a synonym of ambrosial.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of ambrosial: Foul, Fetid.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Degenerate (पतन होना / बिगड़ना): Flourish (उन्नति करना), Improve (सुधारना)

2. Delay (देरी करना): Hasten (जल्दी करना), Accelerate (तेज करना)

3. Delegate (प्रतिनिधि बनाना): Retain (रखना), Keep (संभालना)

4. Deleterious (हानिकारक): Harmless (हानिरहित), Beneficial (लाभकारी)

5. Deliberate (सोच-समझकर): Rash (जल्दबाजी में), Hasty (जल्दी में)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Object."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Assent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Object" means to express disapproval of or opposition to something. (आपत्ति करना)

 

• "Assent" means to express approval or agreement. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सहमति देना)

◦ Example: After a brief discussion, the entire panel gave its assent to the proposed budget changes.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Disagree (असहमत होना) — hold a differing opinion; a synonym of object.

• Option 2: Protest (विरोध करना) — express strong disapproval formally; a synonym of object.

• Option 3: Oppose (विरोध जताना) — actively disagree with something; a synonym of object.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of object: Agree, Consent, Approve.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Delicious (स्वादिष्ट): Distasteful (बेस्वाद), Tasteless (फीका)

2. Delighted (प्रसन्न): Displeased (असंतुष्ट), Unhappy (दुखी)

3. Demented (पागल): Sensible (समझदार), Rational (तर्कसंगत)

4. Demur (आपत्ति): Agree (सहमत होना), Consent (स्वीकृति देना)

5. Denial (अस्वीकार / खंडन): Affirmation (स्वीकार), Acceptance (मान्यता)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Serene".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Chaotic.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Serene" means calm, peaceful, and untroubled. (शांत)

◦ Example: The lake looked serene at dawn, with barely a ripple disturbing its still surface.

 

• "Chaotic" means in a state of complete disorder and confusion, and is therefore the correct antonym. (अशांत)

◦ Example: The evacuation became chaotic as thousands of people rushed toward the exits at once.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Placid (सौम्य/शांत): not easily upset or excited — a synonym of serene, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण): free from conflict or disturbance — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Tranquil (शांत): free from disturbance; calm — close in sense to serene.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of serene: Tranquil, Placid, Peaceful, Calm, Composed.

• Synonyms of chaotic: Disorderly, Turbulent, Confused, Anarchic, Tumultuous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Denounce (आरोप लगाना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Compliment (प्रशंसा करना)

2. Denounce (निंदा करना): Defend (बचाव करना), Praise (प्रशंसा करना)

3. Dependence (निर्भरता): Autonomy (स्वतंत्रता), Independence (आत्मनिर्भरता)

4. Derelict (लापरवाह / परित्यक्त): Attentive (सावधान), Responsible (जिम्मेदार)

5. Derision (उपहास): Admiration (प्रशंसा), Respect (सम्मान)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Definite."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Vague.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Definite" means clearly stated or decided; not vague or ambiguous. (निश्चित)

 

• "Vague" means of uncertain, indefinite, or unclear character or meaning. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अस्पष्ट)

◦ Example: His vague explanation for the missing funds only raised further suspicion among the auditors present.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Certain (निश्चित) — known for sure without doubt; a synonym of definite.

• Option 3: Precise (सटीक) — exact and accurate in detail; a synonym of definite.

• Option 4: Clear (स्पष्ट) — easy to perceive or understand; a synonym of definite.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of definite: Uncertain, Ambiguous, Hazy.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Desecrate (अपवित्र करना): Sanctify (पवित्र करना), Purify (शुद्ध करना)

2. Desolate (उजाड़/निराश): Festive (उत्सवपूर्ण), Cheerful (प्रसन्न)

3. Despair (निराशा): Hope (आशा)

4. Destruction (विनाश): Preservation (संरक्षण), Protection (सुरक्षा)

5. Devout (पवित्र): Treacherous (विश्वासघाती)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Large".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Tiny.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Large" means of considerable or relatively great size or extent. (बड़ा)

◦ Example: The company recently moved into a large office building with enough space for over five hundred employees.

 

• "Tiny" means very small in size or amount, and is therefore the correct antonym. (छोटा)

◦ Example: A tiny insect crawled across the windowsill while the children watched with great curiosity.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Enormous (बहुत बड़ा): very large in size or extent — a synonym of large, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Huge (विशाल): extremely large in size or amount — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Massive (विशालकाय): large and heavy or solid — close in sense to large.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of large: Huge, Massive, Enormous, Big, Vast.

• Synonyms of tiny: Small, Minute, Miniature, Little.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Dexterity (निपुणता): Ignorance (अज्ञान), Clumsiness (अकुशलता)

2. Differ (असहमत होना): Conform (अनुरूप होना), Agree (सहमत होना)

3. Dig (खोदना): Fill (भरना), Cover (ढकना)

4. Dilate (बढ़ाना): Contract (सिकुड़ना), Compress (दबाना)

5. Diligent (मेहनती): Lazy (आलसी), Idle (निष्क्रिय)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Dwindle".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Increase.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Dwindle" means to become gradually smaller or fewer; diminish. (कम होना)

◦ Example: The village's population began to dwindle as young people moved to cities in search of jobs.

 

• "Increase" means to become greater in size, number, or degree, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बढ़ना)

◦ Example: Sales are widely expected to increase significantly during the upcoming festive shopping season this year.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Diminish (कम होना): to make or become less — a synonym of dwindle, not an antonym.

• Option 2: Shrink (सिकुड़ना): to become smaller in size — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Decrease (घटना): to become smaller in size or amount — close in sense to dwindle.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of dwindle: Decrease, Diminish, Shrink, Decline, Wane.

• Synonyms of increase: Grow, Expand, Rise, Multiply, Escalate.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Disadvantage (नुकसान): Advantage (लाभ), Benefit (फायदा)

2. Disagree (असहमत): Concur (सहमत), Agree (सहमति)

3. Discipline (अनुशासन): Carelessness (लापरवाही), Disorder (अव्यवस्था)

4. Discouraged (निराश): Encouraged (प्रोत्साहित), Inspired (प्रेरित)

5. Disenfranchise (अधिकार छीनना): Authorize (अधिकार देना), Empower (सशक्त बनाना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Misanthropic."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Sociable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Misanthropic" means having a general dislike or distrust of humankind. (मानवद्वेषी)

 

• "Sociable" means fond of the company of others; friendly and outgoing. It is therefore the correct antonym. (मिलनसार)

◦ Example: Her sociable personality made her the natural host for every neighborhood gathering that summer.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Reclusive (एकांतप्रिय) — avoiding the company of others; a synonym of misanthropic.

• Option 3: Unfriendly (अमित्र) — not warm or welcoming; a synonym of misanthropic.

• Option 4: Antisocial (असामाजिक) — avoiding contact with other people; a synonym of misanthropic.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of misanthropic: Friendly, Gregarious, Amiable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Disgrace (अपमान): Honour (सम्मान), Respect (आदर)

2. Disgusting (घिनौना): Delightful (सुखद), Pleasant (अच्छा)

3. Disheveled (अस्त-व्यस्त): Tidy (साफ-सुथरा), Organized (व्यवस्थित)

4. Dismal (निराशाजनक): Lively (जीवंत), Cheerful (प्रसन्न)

5. Disparate (भिन्न / असमान): Alike (समान), Similar (एक जैसा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Oppose."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Encourage.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Oppose" means to disagree with or resist strongly. (विरोध करना)

 

• "Encourage" means to give support, confidence, or hope to. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रोत्साहित करना)

◦ Example: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions whenever they feel confused about a topic.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Contest (चुनौती देना) — to challenge or dispute formally; a synonym of oppose.

• Option 2: Object (आपत्ति करना) — to express disapproval or disagreement; a synonym of oppose.

• Option 3: Resist (प्रतिरोध करना) — to try to prevent by action or argument; a synonym of oppose.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of oppose: Support, Promote, Favor.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Dispatch (भेजना): Acquire (प्राप्त करना)

2. Displayed (दिखाया गया): Hidden (छुपा हुआ), Concealed (गुप्त)

3. Dissemble (छिपाना): Reveal (प्रकट करना), Disclose (खुलासा करना)

4. Dissolve (घुलना): Appear (प्रकट होना)

5. Divergence (भिन्नता): Convergence (एकता), Unity (एकरूपता)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Hit".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Miss.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Hit" means strike someone or something forcefully with a hand, object, or weapon. (मारना)

◦ Example: The batsman managed to hit the ball cleanly over the boundary for a spectacular six.

 

• "Miss" means fail to hit, reach, or come into contact with something aimed at, and is therefore the correct antonym. (चूकना)

◦ Example: The archer's final arrow veered off course and completely missed the center of the target.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Strike (प्रहार करना): hit forcefully or deliberately — a synonym of hit, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Slam (जोर से पटकना): hit or shut forcefully and loudly — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Smack (थप्पड़ मारना): hit sharply with the palm — close in sense to hit.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of hit: strike, smack, slam, knock, clout.

• Synonyms of miss: fail, overlook, skip, err.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Diversity (विविधता): Uniformity (एकरूपता)

2. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Headstrong (जिद्दी), Stubborn (हठी)

3. Exemplary (अनुकरणीय): Unsatisfactory (असंतोषजनक)

4. Oppugn (विरोध करना): Defend (बचाव करना), Support (समर्थन करना)

5. Dogmatic (कट्टर): Liberal (उदार), Flexible (लचीला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Traditional."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Modern.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Traditional" means existing in or as part of a long-established custom or practice. (परम्परागत)

 

• "Modern" means relating to the present or recent times; up to date. It is therefore the correct antonym. (आधुनिक)

◦ Example: The architects designed a strikingly modern building using glass, steel, and minimalist geometric lines.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Orthodox (रूढ़िवादी) — following traditional or established beliefs; a synonym of traditional.

• Option 2: Customary (प्रथागत) — according to the customs or usual practices; a synonym of traditional.

• Option 3: Conventional (परंपरागत) — based on what is generally done or believed; a synonym of traditional.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of traditional: Unusual, Innovative, Contemporary.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Dominate (शासन करना): Submit (आत्मसमर्पण करना), Obey (आज्ञा मानना)

2. Durable (टिकाऊ): Fragile (नाजुक), Weak (कमजोर)

3. Dwindle (कम होना): Increase (बढ़ना), Expand (विस्तार होना)

4. Eager (उत्सुक): Indifferent (उदासीन), Uninterested (रुचिहीन)

5. Ebullient (उत्साही): Depressed (उदास), Gloomy (म्लान)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Convince."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Dissuade.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Convince" means cause someone to believe firmly in the truth of something. (मनाना)

 

• "Dissuade" means persuade someone not to take a particular course of action. It is therefore the correct antonym. (रोकना)

◦ Example: Her parents tried to dissuade her from taking up such a risky career in mountaineering.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Persuade (मनाना) — cause someone to do or believe something; a synonym of convince.

• Option 3: Assure (आश्वस्त करना) — tell someone confidently to remove doubt; a synonym of convince.

• Option 4: Satisfy (संतुष्ट करना) — convince someone that something is true; a synonym of convince.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of convince: Discourage, Deter, Divert.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Effervescent (उत्साही): Subdued (शांत), Dull (सुस्त)

2. Egalitarian (समानतावादी): Biased (पक्षपाती), Unequal (असमान)

3. Elated (उत्साहित): Discouraged (निराश), Depressed (उदास)

4. Elegance (सुंदरता/शालीनता): Coarseness (भद्दापन), Roughness (खुरदरापन)

5. Eloquent (प्रभावशाली): Impotent (अप्रभावी), Inexpressive (अभिव्यक्ति रहित)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Delighted".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Displeased.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Delighted" means feeling or showing great pleasure or satisfaction. (प्रसन्न)

◦ Example: The children were absolutely delighted when they discovered the surprise trip to the amusement park that weekend.

 

• "Displeased" means feeling or showing annoyance or dissatisfaction, and is therefore the correct antonym. (असंतुष्ट)

◦ Example: The coach looked visibly displeased with the team's careless performance during the crucial championship match.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 2: Thrilled (रोमांचित): extremely excited and pleased — a synonym of delighted, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Pleased (प्रसन्न): feeling satisfaction or contentment — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Overjoyed (अत्यंत हर्षित): extremely happy or delighted — close in sense to delighted.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of delighted: pleased, overjoyed, thrilled, elated, glad.

• Synonyms of displeased: annoyed, dissatisfied, unhappy, irritated.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Jeopardy (खतरा): Safety (सुरक्षा)

2. Elucidate (स्पष्ट करना): Obscure (अस्पष्ट करना), Confuse (भ्रमित करना)

3. Emaciated (दुबला/कमजोर): Healthy (स्वस्थ), Fatty (मोटा)

4. Eminent (प्रसिद्ध): Obscure (अज्ञात), Unknown (अनजान)

5. Encomium (प्रशंसा): Castigation (निंदा), Criticism (आलोचना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Foment."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Quash.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Foment" means to instigate or stir up trouble, unrest, or violence. (उकसाना)

 

• "Quash" means to suppress or put an end to something forcefully. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दबाना)

◦ Example: The government moved swiftly to quash the rebellion before it could spread to neighboring provinces.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Instigate (भड़काना) — to bring about or initiate an action; a synonym of foment.

• Option 2: Provoke (उत्तेजित करना) — to stir up a strong reaction deliberately; a synonym of foment.

• Option 4: Incite (उकसाना) — to encourage someone to act violently or unlawfully; a synonym of foment.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of foment: Suppress, Regulate, Calm.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Encourage (प्रोत्साहित): Dishearten (निरुत्साहित), Prevented (रोका गया)

2. Enhance (बढ़ाना): Diminish (घटाना), Reduce (कम करना)

3. Enquired (पूछा): Answered (उत्तर दिया), Replied (उत्तर देना)

4. Ensconce (छिपाना): Unveil (प्रकट करना), Reveal (खोलना)

5. Enthralled (मोहित): Bored (उबाऊ)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Give up."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Persist.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Give up" means to stop trying to do something; abandon an effort. (हार मानना)

 

• "Persist" means to continue firmly in a course of action despite difficulty. It is therefore the correct antonym. (डटे रहना)

◦ Example: Researchers must persist through repeated failures before finally discovering an effective treatment for the disease.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Quit (छोड़ देना) — to stop doing something; give up; a synonym of give up.

• Option 3: Abandon (त्याग देना) — to give up completely and leave behind; a synonym of give up.

• Option 4: Surrender (आत्मसमर्पण करना) — to stop resisting and give in; a synonym of give up.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of give up: Continue, Persevere, Endure.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Entire (पूरा): Incomplete (अधूरा), Partial (आंशिक)

2. Entrenched (स्थापित): Transient (क्षणिक)

3. Envious (ईर्ष्यालु): Generous (उदार), Content (संतुष्ट)

4. Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर): Eternal (शाश्वत), Permanent (स्थायी)

5. Epitome (नमूना): Opposite (विपरीत), Contrast (विरोध)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Sporadic."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Frequent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Sporadic" means occurring at irregular intervals; occasional. (अनियमित)

 

• "Frequent" means occurring often or at close intervals. It is therefore the correct antonym. (बार-बार)

◦ Example: Frequent visits to the dentist are recommended to maintain good oral health.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Irregular (अनियमित) — not evenly or uniformly occurring; a synonym of sporadic.

• Option 2: Intermittent (रुक-रुक कर होने वाला) — occurring at irregular intervals; a synonym of sporadic.

• Option 3: Occasional (कभी-कभार) — happening infrequently and irregularly; a synonym of sporadic.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of sporadic: Regular, Recurrent, Common.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Erudite (विद्वान): Uninformed (अज्ञानी), Ignorant (अनजान)

2. Escalate (बढ़ाना): Reduce (कम करना), Diminish (घटाना)

3. Esoteric (गूढ़): Straightforward (सरल), Clear (स्पष्ट)

4. Established (स्थापित): Displaced (विस्थापित)

5. Euphemism (मंगलभाषी): Directness (सीधापन), Bluntness (सपष्टता)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "Harass".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Comfort.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Harass" means to subject someone to repeated aggressive pressure, intimidation, or annoyance. (तंग करना)

◦ Example: Employees who harass their colleagues at the workplace face strict disciplinary action under company policy.

 

• "Comfort" means to soothe or ease someone's grief, distress, or fear, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सांत्वना देना)

◦ Example: Volunteers arrived at the flood relief camp to comfort survivors who had lost their homes.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Pester (तंग करना): to annoy someone with persistent requests or interruptions — a synonym of harass, not an antonym.

• Option 3: Harry (तंग करना): to repeatedly harass or attack someone — again a synonym.

• Option 4: Torment (पीड़ा देना): to cause someone severe mental or physical suffering — close in sense to harass.

 

NOTE

• Synonyms of harass: Torment, Pester, Harry, Bully, Persecute.

• Synonyms of comfort: Console, Soothe, Reassure, Ease.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Evade (बचना): Confront (सामना करना), Face (सामना करना)

2. Evanescent (क्षणभंगुर): Enduring (स्थायी), Permanent (स्थायी)

3. Evasive (कपटपूर्ण/टालने वाला): Truthful (सत्यवादी), Direct (सीधा)

4. Everlasting (शाश्वत): Transient (क्षणिक)

5. Evident (स्पष्ट): Hidden (छिपा), Obscure (अस्पष्ट)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Active."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Inert.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Active" means engaging regularly in physical effort or energetic action. (सक्रिय)

 

• "Inert" means lacking the ability or strength to move; inactive. It is therefore the correct antonym. (निष्क्रिय)

◦ Example: The gas remained inert and did not react even when exposed to an open flame.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Dynamic (गतिशील) — characterized by constant activity or change; a synonym of active.

• Option 2: Vigorous (जोशीला) — strong, healthy, and full of energy; a synonym of active.

• Option 3: Energetic (ऊर्जावान) — showing or involving great activity; a synonym of active.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of active: Passive, Dormant.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Evince (प्रकट करना): Conceal (छिपाना), Hide (गुप्त रखना)

2. Exacerbate (बिगाड़ना): Alleviate (कम करना), Improve (सुधारना)

3. Exemplary (अनुकरणीय): Unsatisfactory (असंतोषजनक)

4. Exiguous (कम): Plentiful (प्रचुर), Abundant (बहुत अधिक)

5. Exit (निकास): Entry (प्रवेश), Entrance (प्रवेश द्वार)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Hospitality."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Coldness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Hospitality" means the friendly and generous reception and entertainment of guests or strangers. (अतिथि सत्कार)

 

• "Coldness" means a lack of warmth or affection in manner; unfriendliness. It is therefore the correct antonym. (बेरुख़ी, ठंडापन)

◦ Example: The manager's coldness toward new employees made it difficult for them to feel welcome at the office.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Welcome (स्वागत) — an instance of greeting someone warmly; a synonym of hospitality.

• Option 2: Generosity (उदारता) — the quality of being kind and giving; a synonym of hospitality.

• Option 3: Warmth (गर्मजोशी) — friendliness and affection; a synonym of hospitality.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of hospitality: Inhospitality, Hostility, Unfriendliness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Exonerate (दोषमुक्त करना): Convict (दोषी ठहराना), Accuse (आरोप लगाना)

2. Exotic (अनोखा): Familiar (परिचित), Common (सामान्य)

3. Expensive (महंगा): Cheap (सस्ता), Affordable (सुलभ)

4. Expunge (मिटाना): Insert (जोड़ना), Add (शामिल करना)

5. Exquisite (अत्यंत सुंदर): Coarse (भद्दा), Rough (खुरदरा)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Mechanical."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Manual.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Mechanical" means operated by a machine, or performed automatically without much thought. (यांत्रिक)

 

• "Manual" means done or operated by hand rather than by machine. It is therefore the correct antonym. (हस्तचालित)

◦ Example: Without electricity, the workers had to rely on manual labor to move the heavy crates.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Automatic (स्वचालित) — operating without direct human control; a synonym of mechanical.

• Option 2: Robotic (यंत्रवत) — resembling or performed by a machine; a synonym of mechanical.

• Option 4: Motorized (मोटर-चालित) — fitted with a motor or engine; a synonym of mechanical.

 

NOTE

• Other antonyms of mechanical: Natural, Human, By-hand.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Extinguished (बुझा हुआ): Ignited (प्रज्वलित), Lit (जला हुआ)

2. Exuberant (उत्साही): Repressed (दबा हुआ), Depressed (उदास)

3. Exultant (उल्लसित): Disconsolate (उदास), Miserable (दुखी)

4. Fact (सत्य): Fiction (काल्पनिक), Myth (कहानी)

5. Failed (असफल): Passed (सफल), Succeeded (सफल हुआ)
